description.desc: Spew an incendiary mixture, dealing spirit damage, applying slow, and coating targets in napalm.

description.desc: Weapon hits build up a burning effect, dealing spirit damage over time. Abilities refresh to the base burn duration and weapon hits extend it.

description.t3_desc: -0.75s Cooldown +1 Max Marks Stun Victim for 0.5s on Max Marks
description.passive: Passive: Your shots apply a Djinn Mark on the target. When the mark expires or is consumed, it deals spirit damage and the target is briefly revealed on the map. Each added mark doubles the current damage.There is a per target Cooldown for applying additional marks

description.desc: Target a location on the minimap. After a brief wait, teleport to that location. Taking damage during the wait period causes the teleport to be interrupted.
description.quip: Teleport to an ally or enemy hero
description.t1_desc: +3m Move Speed and +20% Fire Rate for 12s

description.desc: Throw a dagger, dealing spirit damage and applying slow. Every subsequent dagger against the same target stacks in spirit damage and slow.
description.quip: Throw a slowing dagger
description.t2_desc: On Hit: -8% Bullet Resist and -6% Bullet Resist per Stack
description.t3_desc: +2 Max Stacks-2s Charge DelayOn Hit: Refund 55% Charge Cooldown

description.desc: Inject a target with lethal venom. After a delay the venom triggers, dealing Spirit Damage. The damage is increased by the target's missing health.Lethal Venom will ignore Petrify's damage block.
description.quip: Inject your enemies with a deadly venom
description.t3_desc: Bullets also build up Lethal Venom

description.desc: You have increased Slide Distance, can Slide up hills, and can turn faster while Sliding.
description.quip: Increase the agility of your Slide
description.t3_desc: On Slide: Gain 180 barrier for 4s

description.desc: Throw an explosive bola. On exploding, the bola Slows and Damages all enemies in the area. Direct hits deal Additional Damage and Petrify instead. Petrified units block all damage, but cannot take actions.
description.quip: Toss a petrifying bola
description.t3_desc: +1.0s Petrify Duration. Petrifies all enemies in the area.

description.desc: Fire a bolt of magic that deals Damage, increasing as it travels. If you have an Assistant, they also cast Vexing Bolt at reduced damage. Press Ability 1 to redirect the bolt towards your crosshairs.
description.quip: Launch a guided bolt of magic
description.t3_desc: +126.0 Max Damage. +50.0% Assistant Damage.

description.desc: Summon an Assistant at the targeted location. The Assistant attacks whenever you fire your weapon, dealing Damage. While the Assistant is out, you can press Ability 2 to swap positions with your Assistant. Casting Spectral Assistant also reloads your weapon.
description.quip: Summon your faithful assistant
description.t3_desc: +60% Fire Rate and +12.599999 Assistant Damage

description.desc: Hex a target area and transform all enemies into a Rabbit for a limited duration. Rabbits are small and move faster, but take increased Damage and are unable to perform most actions.Hex does not interrupt abilities.
description.t3_desc: +7% Damage Amp and +2m Radius

description.desc: Copy the Ultimate of an enemy hero for a limited time. Reactivating the ability will use the Copied Ultimate instead.Copies will inherit this ability's upgrade points.Audience Participation will also copy the cooldown.
description.quip: Copy an enemy's Ultimate for a limited time
description.t3_desc: Upgrade the Copy ONCE AGAIN!
+7.0% Missing health damage and increased Heal per Kill Spirit scaling

description.desc: Briefly disperse, becoming untargetable and flying to a target location. Can be recast within a brief window.
description.t1_desc: On Cast: Gain +25% Fire Rate for 8s and add 8 bullets
description.t3_desc: +1 Recast+4m Range

description.desc: Your bullets apply additional spirit damage. Dealing damage with your abilities builds up to a vicious bite, dealing a burst of bonus spirit damage. Love Bites has a unique cooldown per target.
description.t2_desc: +3.0 Spirit Damage per Bullet & +45.0 Bonus Damage
description.t3_desc: -5 Cooldown On Proc: +25% Fire Rate for 5s

description.desc: Active: Unleash a cloud of bats that seek out targets, each dealing spirit damage and applying Silence.Passive: Triggering Love Bites against heroes permanently increases the number of bats released.
description.t3_desc: On Hit: Deal +0.5% Current Health as Damage

description.desc: Swipe at enemies in a cone ahead of you, dealing spirit damage. If the enemy is in close range, deal bonus melee damage.
description.t3_desc: Deals 55% Heavy Melee DamageSilences enemies for 2s if close range

description.desc: Send out a mark that bleeds the first target it hits, dealing spirit damage over time.While the enemy is bleeding you can re-activate Stalker's Mark to instantly appear behind their back.
description.t3_desc: +1.5% Bleed and -40.0% Incoming Healing

description.t1_desc: +3m/s Move Speed when around an isolated enemy hero
description.t2_desc: On isolated hero death: Heal 24% of your missing health and restores 2 Stamina
description.active: Active: Accentuate your senses, revealing a trail that leads to nearby heroes.
description.passive: Isolated heroes leave a trail as they move, and emit their heartbeat from afar. You deal amplified damage against isolated heroes, and when isolated heroes die nearby you gain permanent weapon damage.

description.desc: Surround nearby enemy heroes in darkness, severely limiting their vision of other units. Affected enemies are briefly revealed to you and are considered isolated for the duration.You gain bonus sprint speed.
description.t3_desc: +2.5s Duration and +1 Max Target.

description.desc: Fire a grenade that bounces before exploding, dealing weapon damage and setting enemies on fire. Burning targets deal pure damage to enemies in the area and suffer from reduced healing.
description.t3_desc: -20% Incoming Healing and allow Charges

description.desc: Fire a blast with your shotgun, dealing weapon damage and pushing enemies back. Enemies near a wall receive stun and take bonus weapon damage.
description.t3_desc: On Wall Stun: Your next heavy melee is blessed

description.desc: Kick a trap that arms after a brief delay. The trap springs on the first enemy it touches, dealing spirit damage, applying immobilize, and revealing enemies for a duration afterwards.
description.t3_desc: +1 ChargeDeal +30% damage against revealed targets

description.desc: Load your crossbow with 3 stakes, dealing massively increased weapon damage.The final stake is blessed, dealing bonus pure damage and executing low-health enemies.
description.t1_desc: While Active: Gain 1.2 m/s Move Speed
description.t3_desc: All Stakes are Blessed

description.desc: Taking any damage passively charges up your Pain Battery. Once full, activating the ability fires multiple shocking bolts, dealing spirit damage once per target.
description.t3_desc: On Hero Hit: Heal for 15% of your missing health and increased Spirit scaling

description.desc: Deal spirit damage to yourself. Then, gain bonus regeneration and bonus move speed, decaying over time.
description.t3_desc: +1 Charge+50% Debuff ResistanceIncreases spirit scaling

description.desc: Unleash pain, dealing spirit damage over time to both enemies and yourself. The damage continues to increase the longer the ability is channeled, up to a maximum amount.
description.t1_desc: Enemies receive 20% Move and Dash Slow
description.t3_desc: +1m RadiusEnemies take +15% Damage

description.desc: Release a wave after taking lethal damage, applying a diminishing slow. After a brief channel you reanimate, dealing spirit damage and applying stun to nearby enemies.
description.t1_desc: While On Cooldown: Gain +15% Fire Rate and 6.0 Spirit Damage per Bullet
description.t3_desc: +175 Damage+1.5 Stun -95.0s Cooldown

description.desc: Conjure a dragon that appears at the target location before flying forward, dealing spirit damage and leaving a burning path in its trail.
description.t3_desc: +12m Travel Range+100.0 Damage +30.0 DPS

description.desc: Grant an ally a barrier. While the barrier holds, they gain bonus weapon damage.
description.t3_desc: Affects up to 2 additional allies.Increases barrier scaling.

description.desc: Target an area with latent magic, applying slow. The magic detonates after a delay, dealing spirit damage and applying immobilize.
description.t3_desc: +2m RadiusOn Hit: Reduce Spirit Resist by -18% for 6s

description.desc: Release a wave of spectral knights and steeds that charge across the entire city, healing allies and dealing spirit damage to enemies. The strength of the heal and spirit damage is amplified as the knights travel further.
description.t3_desc: +160.0 Damage +0.5s Stun Duration+70% Max Amp

description.desc: Throw out a call bell that deals spirit damage on impact. After a short delay it explodes, dealing additional spirit damage and causing affected enemies to suffer reduced weapon accuracy and movement slow.Can be shot to detonate early.
description.t3_desc: +4.5m Radius+26s Bell LifetimeImproved Scaling

description.desc: Place two connected doors in the world. Players and most projectiles entering one door will exit out through the other. The doors will close at the end of the duration.The two doors must be placed within the doorway distance of each other.
description.t2_desc: Grants a Barrier first time traveling through doors
description.t3_desc: +30m Cast Range. +40m Doorway Distance and scales with Spirit Power.

description.desc: Send out a Luggage Cart that deals spirit damage and pulls enemy heroes along its path. Can be alt cast with to target friendly heroes instead.
description.t2_desc: +25m Cast Range+75 Damage on wall impact
description.t3_desc: -15s Cooldown and 1.25s stun on wall impact

description.desc: Send the target's physical body to be a guest at the Baroness Hotel. The guest is to promptly make their way to the exit elevator, where they'll be sent back to their original position. A stay at the Baroness Hotel is paid for in spirit damage. Failure to check-out on time costs additional spirit damage.
description.t2_desc: +150 Damage+1.5s Stun on Failure to Check Out
description.t3_desc: Unstoppable while the Baroness is occupied.15s Cooldown on Failure to Check Out.

description.desc: Slam your bat into the ground, pulling enemies down and dealing melee damage.The slam creates a shockwave that deals spirit damage and applies knockup.
description.t3_desc: -3.0s Charge TimeNow deals 50% Heavy Melee Damage

description.desc: Charge head-first into an enemy and send them into the air along with Billy.Cooldown reduced by 50% on impact.
Passive: Melee hits restore ammo and inflict wrecked on the victim for 7.0s.
description.t2_desc: +1 Bashdown Charge on use and +7% Wrecked Bullet Amp
description.t3_desc: +50 Melee Bonus Health and increases spirit scaling
description.active: Active: Bullets are amplified against wrecked enemies. Using melee boosts max health and extends duration.

description.desc: Chain nearby enemies to you. Chained enemies cannot use movement abilities and receive a heavy slow when they pull on the chain.After a delay, yank everyone towards Billy and deal spirit damage.The chain breaks if you lose line of sight for a short while.
description.t3_desc: +5m Range +1.3s of Unstoppable Per Hero pulled in

description.desc: Passive: Collect death when anything dies nearby and store it in your Jar of Dead.Active: Throw a jar to summon Deadheads that repeatedly deal spirit damage to enemies. Deadheads follow you instead if there's no nearby enemies, and prioritize the target of your weapon.
description.t1_desc: Collecting death heals 5 health per pickup
description.t3_desc: +2 Deadheads+4s Deadhead Lifetime

description.desc: Unearth a line of grasping hands, summoning a Ghoul and leaving behind a rift. Enemies who pass through take spirit damage and receive immobilize. Alt-Cast rotates the orientation of the wall.
description.t3_desc: +1 Ghouls Raised -14s Cooldown+0.75s Immobilize Duration

description.desc: Your weapon steals weapon damage and spirit resist over time, up to a maximum amount per target.
description.t3_desc: +1 Max Steal TargetsAll Summons now apply Essence Theft
On Death: Deal +5% Current Health as Damage

description.desc: Draw a sigil sphere in front of you and then leap backwards as it explodes, damaging and slowing enemies caught in it.
description.t1_desc: Gain +25% Fire Rate and +25% Bullet Speed for 8s
description.t2_desc: On Player Hit: +1 stamina restored and resets Air Jump/Dash limit
description.t3_desc: Can be Recast within 4s

description.desc: Prepare to deflect the next incoming attack. On a successful deflection, briefly become invulnerable and target an enemy hero to dash towards them, stunning them and reducing their Melee Resist.Press Ability 2 to select a target.Does not trigger against trooper or neutral damage.
description.t3_desc: Gain 75% Bullet, Spirit & Melee Lifesteal against the Riposte target for 13s

description.desc: Perform a series of lunges in any direction, delivering piercing stabs ahead of you. Hold your ability key to time your attacks, dealing more damage the longer it's held. Releasing your attack during the perfect window deals maximum damage.Press Ability 3 to re-cast.
description.t2_desc: -12s Cooldown. Gain +60% Bullet Resist during lunge
description.t3_desc: +65 Perfect Damage with improved Spirit scaling.Increased lunge speed & distance.

description.desc: Charge up and perform a long range slash. Struck enemies cannot take action or heal and are stuck in slow motion. When this effect expires, they suffer devastating damage, dealing bonus damage against half-health enemies.While in slow motion, Apollo is invulnerable and enemies take reduced damage.Hold Ability 4 or to delay the cast.

Launch a salvo of spirit missiles that lodge into the ground along a line. The missiles explode after a delay or upon detecting an enemy, dealing spirit damage and marking the target.Shooting a marked enemy with a charged shot consumes a mark to deal bonus spirit damage and apply a fading slow.Hold and drag to select the angle.
description.t3_desc: +2 Missiles, Longer Range, and Improved Spirit Scaling

description.desc: Hold Jump / mantle to fly, building up heat. When max heat is reached, your jetpack will begin to overheat.Overheating: After a short delay, dive to the ground. Upon impact, create an explosion that deals damage and launches you and nearby enemies. If no hero is hit, you stun yourself. Press Ability 2 to dive early.Cooling Down: After overheating, the jetpack cannot be used until it fully cools down.Slows affect you while airborne. You always explode on death.
description.t2_desc: On Hero Hit: Heal and take no self damage
description.t3_desc: On Hero Hit: -50% Cooldown and +120 Spirit Damage

description.desc: Spray fuel dealing weapon damage over time and shredding bullet resist, building up to a huge backblast that deals spirit damage and knocks you backwards.Vents the jetpack when dealing damage.
description.t2_desc: +60 Burst DamageOn Backblast Hit: +18% Fire Rate for 7s
description.t3_desc: -10% Bullet Resist ShredOn Backblast Hit: Apply a Mark

description.desc: Grab an enemy and give them a hands-on demonstration, flying high into the air before crashing back to the ground.You and the participant take spirit damage over time while falling and spirit damage upon impact. Damage is increased to enemies under 50% health.
description.t3_desc: +0.5s Stun+8.0 Damage / Meter

description.desc: Throw your trusty pillow inflicting spirit damage and heavy knockback.Landing hits reduces the cooldown of your other abilities.
description.t3_desc: +100 Damage and +1 Charge

description.desc: Jump to an ally and nap alongside them. Both you and the ally receive a burst heal based on missing health followed by lingering regeneration.Hop between allies with Ability 2 to apply the heal, once per ally.You are knocked off if stunned by an ultimate ability.You can use items and all self-casts target your ally instead.
description.t2_desc: 35% Bonus Item Range, Duration, and Barrier Effectiveness while napping
description.t3_desc: +15% Spirit Power and +35 Spirit Power while napping and for 10s after nappingImproved Spirit Scaling

description.desc: Signal a Helper to lend a hand. They can collect boxes, do Sinner's Sacrifices, or be sent to support allies and troopers.Follow a hero: Provides a short burst of spirit resist and fading move speed.Follow a trooper: Provides healing, damage, resists, and allows tagging along. When no hero is around, souls from trooper kills are split amongst the team.Can be cast during Tag Along. Helpers will take a nap for 15.1s after following someone.
description.t3_desc: +1 Helper+15% Spirit Resist

description.desc: Cast your gaze forward, piercing walls and floors. Enemies in the gaze are slowed, have reduced dash distance, and cannot use movement abilities.When the channel ends they fall asleep before waking up to a splitting headache that deals heavy spirit damage.
description.t1_desc: -1 Stamina On Wake and no Stamina Regen while sleeping
description.t3_desc: -55s cooldown Reduced damage and unstoppable while channeling

description.desc: Instantly reload your gun. You gain bonus fire rate and deal bonus weapon damage based on the target's health for a limited number of shots, but suffer from reduced accuracy.Deals bonus Weapon Damage against troopers and neutrals.
description.t3_desc: If you hit all shots, deal +7% current health as damage
+80 Bonus Damage and kicked enemies deal -35% Damage for 5s

description.desc: Throw a bola, dealing spirit damage, applying slow and preventing movement abilities or stamina.
description.t3_desc: +0.75s Debuff Duration.Bola ricochets to 2 additional targets

description.desc: Passive: Dealing damage generates bloodlust, increased at low health. At max bloodlust, you automatically cast Lycan Curse.Active: Instantly transform, gaining increased max health, and stacking fire rate on enemy heroes, and replacing your abilities and weapon with their ferocious versions.
description.t2_desc: +4 m/s Move Speed and 200 Bonus Health
description.t3_desc: On Hero Kill: Refresh abilities and duration

description.desc: Blast enemies in a cone in front of you with a flare of light. Blasted enemies take spirit damage when attacked by Celeste and provides her spirit lifesteal.
description.t3_desc: +22 Damage and Increased Spirit Scaling

description.desc: Surround yourself in a protective prism. If the barrier is destroyed, it silences nearby enemies and deals a portion of the barrier as damage.
description.t2_desc: +70 Barrier and Increased Barrier Spirit Scaling
description.t3_desc: +1.25 Silence Duration and -20s Cooldown. Allows Shining Wonder Bounce.

description.desc: Call down a beam of light from the sky. After a short duration, the beam will fully form, causing an explosion that deals spirit damage to all targets in the area. Celeste will receive a stacking buff that increases her spirit damage anytime this hits an enemy hero.

Launch a deadly orb of light that deals spirit damage and applies slow and reduces Dash Distance on impact. The orb then bounces to the enemies within range. If no target is found, the orb will linger for a short duration while continuing to look for targets.Prioritizes enemy heroes when picking targets.
description.t3_desc: +6 Max Bounces and -30s Cooldown

description.desc: Throw a grenade of scrap that detonates multiple times, dealing bullet damage and applying slow.The grenade can be meleed to knock it away.
description.t3_desc: Add an additional final Bigger Detonation

description.desc: Call forth a swarm of rats that leap onto enemies, dealing spirit damage over time and reducing their bullet resist with every bite. The more rats are attached, the faster they will bite the target.Enemies can have multiple rats attached, but can shake off a rat early by performing a ground or air dash.
description.t3_desc: +8 Damage and -1% Bullet Resist per Bite

description.desc: Adorn scrappy armor, gaining barrier based on your max health. As long as the armor holds, bullets have a chance to be deflected back towards the attacker.The barrier does not benefit from resists.
description.t3_desc: Reduce all damage to a max of 250+10% Max Health as Barrier

description.desc: Charge up and summon the banner of Ratannia, granting all nearby allies increased move speed, immunity from slows, and reduced incoming damage while near the banner.
description.t3_desc: +150 Damage and +10% Damage Reduction

description.desc: Create a bishop that remains in place indefinitely. Move ( ): Moves the bishop, applying a fading slow and dealing spirit damage to enemies it passes through. After a delay, activates diagonal squares that deal additional spirit damage when stepped on.Re-activate to recall all bishops, ending the ability.
description.t3_desc: +1 Square RangeSquares reduce Spirit Resist by -2.5%, stacking 10 times

description.desc: Promote an ally to be a knight, granting bonus stamina and barrier for a duration.If self-cast you develop yourself as king instead, granting double the barrier but no stamina. Move ( ): Moves the piece, making it invulnerable during the duration before landing. If self-cast, re-activate the ability to move instead.
description.t3_desc: Can target two allies within radius.On Self: Remove all debuffs after a move

description.desc: Release a pair of rooks that travel forward, dealing spirit damage and applying immobilize. If the rooks hit a wall, they reflect back in the opposite direction. Re-Activate: Split the rooks perpendicularly.
description.t1_desc: On Hit: Reduce 25% Fire Rate for 5s
description.t2_desc: On Hit: 5% Current Health as Damage
description.t3_desc: +1 Wall Reflects-12s Cooldown+0.5s Immobilize Duration

description.t2_desc: +15% Slow. Checkmates heroes below 200 health, executing them.
description.t3_desc: +2 Moves+1 Square Range

description.desc: Throw a jar of leeches that attach to enemies, dealing spirit damage over time and eating away at the duration of enemy buffs.
description.t1_desc: Leeches drain stamina and restore it to you on pickup
description.t3_desc: +1m Radius+0.3 Spirit Scaling+8 Max Leech Stacks

description.desc: Crack open a vial to release an ethereal vapor onto yourself or an ally that causes a rush, then a crash.Specter Rush: While it lasts, increases the speed of all actions and temporarily numbs all incoming damage creating looming specters.Specter Crash: When the vapors wear off, all actions are slower and any remaining specters deal their delayed damage plus extra damage.Incoming healing will prioritize removing specters first, preventing them from dealing damage.
description.t3_desc: +15% Rush SpeedDispels non-ult debuffs

description.desc: Load your weapon with a full clip of syringes that heal allies. Dealing damage recovers charges, and each leech you have collected slowly restores them.Reloading spends a charge for a fresh clip.Unused syringes are refunded as a partial charge. Recast to put them away.
description.t3_desc: +0.4 Spirit ScalingShots extend non-ultimate buff durations by 6%, up to their max duration

description.desc: Open your bag and reveal the horrors you carry inside, dealing spirit damage over time to enemies in front of you. Enemies looking at you build up terror and cannot use stamina or movement abilities. At max terror, they flee in fear away from you.Each leech you have collected adds fear duration.Enemies facing away from you take 50% damage unless feared.
description.t2_desc: -20% Move Speed and Fire Rate+30 DPS
description.t3_desc: +3.0s Channel Time+0.5 Spirit ScalingImmune to damage while channeling
